translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "You will find me, if Allah wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in [any] order."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Allah willing, thou shalt find me patient and I shall not in aught gainsay thee.
translations.en.yusufali: Moses said: "Thou wilt find me, if Allah so will, (truly) patient: nor shall I disobey thee in aught."
translations.id.indonesian: Musa berkata: "Insya Allah kamu akan mendapati aku sebagai orang yang sabar, dan aku tidak akan menentangmu dalam sesuatu urusanpun".

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتَنِى فَلَا تَسْـَٔلْنِى عَن شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًۭا
transliteration: Qaala fa init taba'tanee falaa tas'alnee 'an shai'in hattaaa uhdisa laka minhu zikraa

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I make to you about it mention."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Well, if thou go with me, ask me not concerning aught till I myself make mention of it unto thee.
translations.en.yusufali: The other said: "If then thou wouldst follow me, ask me no questions about anything until I myself speak to thee concerning it."
translations.id.indonesian: Dia berkata: "Jika kamu mengikutiku, maka janganlah kamu menanyakan kepadaku tentang sesuatu apapun, sampai aku sendiri menerangkannya kepadamu".

arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِى ٱلسَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا ۖ قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًٔا إِمْرًۭا
transliteration: Fantalaqaa hattaaa izaa rakibaa fis safeenati kharaqahaa qaala akharaqtahaa litughriqa ahlahaa laqad ji'ta shai'an imraa

translations.en.sahih: So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, al-Khidh r tore it open. [Moses] said, "Have you torn it open to drown its people? You have certainly done a grave thing."
translations.en.pickthall: So they twain set out till, when they were in the ship, he made a hole therein. (Moses) said: Hast thou made a hole therein to drown the folk thereof? Thou verily hast done a dreadful thing.
translations.en.yusufali: So they both proceeded: until, when they were in the boat, he scuttled it. Said Moses: "Hast thou scuttled it in order to drown those in it? Truly a strange thing hast thou done!"
translations.id.indonesian: Maka berjalanlah keduanya, hingga tatkala keduanya menaiki perahu lalu Khidhr melobanginya. Musa berkata: "Mengapa kamu melobangi perahu itu akibatnya kamu menenggelamkan penumpangnya?" Sesungguhnya kamu telah berbuat sesuatu kesalahan yang besar.

arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًۭا
transliteration: Qaala alam aqul innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabraa

translations.en.sahih: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me?
translations.en.yusufali: He answered: "Did I not tell thee that thou canst have no patience with me?"
translations.id.indonesian: Dia (Khidhr) berkata: "Bukankah aku telah berkata: "Sesungguhnya kamu sekali-kali tidak akan sabar bersama dengan aku".

arabic: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِى بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِى مِنْ أَمْرِى عُسْرًۭا
transliteration: Qaala laa tu'aakhiznee bimaa naseetu wa laa turhiqnee min amree 'usraa

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "Do not blame me for what I forgot and do not cover me in my matter with difficulty."
translations.en.pickthall: (Moses) said: Be not wroth with me that I forgot, and be not hard upon me for my fault.
translations.en.yusufali: Moses said: "Rebuke me not for forgetting, nor grieve me by raising difficulties in my case."
translations.id.indonesian: Musa berkata: "Janganlah kamu menghukum aku karena kelupaanku dan janganlah kamu membebani aku dengan sesuatu kesulitan dalam urusanku".

arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَٰمًۭا فَقَتَلَهُۥ قَالَ أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا زَكِيَّةًۢ بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍۢ لَّقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًۭٔا نُّكْرًۭا
transliteration: Fantalaqaa hattaa izaa laqiyaa ghulaaman faqatalahoo qaala aqatalta nafsan zakiy yatam bighairi nafs; laqad ji'ta shai'an nukraa

translations.en.sahih: So they set out, until when they met a boy, al-Khidh r killed him. [Moses] said, "Have you killed a pure soul for other than [having killed] a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing."
translations.en.pickthall: So they twain journeyed on till, when they met a lad, he slew him. (Moses) said: What! Hast thou slain an innocent soul who hath slain no man? Verily thou hast done a horrid thing.
translations.en.yusufali: Then they proceeded: until, when they met a young man, he slew him. Moses said: "Hast thou slain an innocent person who had slain none? Truly a foul (unheard of) thing hast thou done!"
translations.id.indonesian: Maka berjalanlah keduanya; hingga tatkala keduanya berjumpa dengan seorang anak, maka Khidhr membunuhnya. Musa berkata: "Mengapa kamu membunuh jiwa yang bersih, bukan karena dia membunuh orang lain? Sesungguhnya kamu telah melakukan suatu yang mungkar".

arabic: ۞ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًۭا
transliteration: Qaala alam aqul laka innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabraa

translations.en.sahih: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me?
translations.en.yusufali: He answered: "Did I not tell thee that thou canst have no patience with me?"
translations.id.indonesian: Khidhr berkata: "Bukankah sudah kukatakan kepadamu, bahwa sesungguhnya kamu tidak akan dapat sabar bersamaku?"

arabic: قَالَ إِن سَأَلْتُكَ عَن شَىْءٍۭ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَٰحِبْنِى ۖ قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِن لَّدُنِّى عُذْرًۭا
transliteration: Qaala in sa altuka 'an shai'im ba'dahaa falaa tusaahibnee qad balaghta mil ladunnee 'uzraa

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "If I should ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me as a companion. You have obtained from me an excuse."
translations.en.pickthall: (Moses) said: If I ask thee after this concerning aught, keep not company with me. Thou hast received an excuse from me.
translations.en.yusufali: (Moses) said: "If ever I ask thee about anything after this, keep me not in thy company: then wouldst thou have received (full) excuse from my side."
translations.id.indonesian: Musa berkata: "Jika aku bertanya kepadamu tentang sesuatu sesudah (kali) ini, maka janganlah kamu memperbolehkan aku menyertaimu, sesungguhnya kamu sudah cukup memberikan uzur padaku".

arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَيَآ أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ ٱسْتَطْعَمَآ أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا۟ أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًۭا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًۭا
transliteration: Fantalaqaa hattaaa izaaa atayaaa ahla qaryatinis tat'amaaa ahlahaa fa abaw any yudaiyifoohumaa fawajadaa feehaa jidaarany yureedu any yanqadda fa aqaamah; qaala law shi'ta lattakhazta 'alaihi ajraa

translations.en.sahih: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so al-Khidh r restored it. [Moses] said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment."
translations.en.pickthall: So they twain journeyed on till, when they came unto the folk of a certain township, they asked its folk for food, but they refused to make them guests. And they found therein a wall upon the point of falling into ruin, and he repaired it. (Moses) said: If thou hadst wished, thou couldst have taken payment for it.
translations.en.yusufali: Then they proceeded: until, when they came to the inhabitants of a town, they asked them for food, but they refused them hospitality. They found there a wall on the point of falling down, but he set it up straight. (Moses) said: "If thou hadst wished, surely thou couldst have exacted some recompense for it!"
translations.id.indonesian: Maka keduanya berjalan; hingga tatkala keduanya sampai kepada penduduk suatu negeri, mereka minta dijamu kepada penduduk negeri itu, tetapi penduduk negeri itu tidak mau menjamu mereka, kemudian keduanya mendapatkan dalam negeri itu dinding rumah yang hampir roboh, maka Khidhr menegakkan dinding itu. Musa berkata: "Jikalau kamu mau, niscaya kamu mengambil upah untuk itu".

arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنِكَ ۚ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا
transliteration: Qaala haazaa firaaqu bainee wa bainik; sa unabi 'uka bitaaweeli maa lam tastati' 'alaihi sabraa

translations.en.sahih: [Al-Khidh r] said, "This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: This is the parting between thee and me! I will announce unto thee the interpretation of that thou couldst not bear with patience.
translations.en.yusufali: He answered: "This is the parting between me and thee: now will I tell thee the interpretation of (those things) over which thou wast unable to hold patience.
translations.id.indonesian: Khidhr berkata: "Inilah perpisahan antara aku dengan kamu; kelak akan kuberitahukan kepadamu tujuan perbuatan-perbuatan yang kamu tidak dapat sabar terhadapnya.

arabic: أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَٰكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكٌۭ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًۭا
transliteration: Ammas safeenatu fakaanat limasaakeena ya'maloona fil bahri fa arattu an a'eebahaa wa kaana waraaa' ahum malikuny yaakhuzu kulla safeenatin ghasbaa

translations.en.sahih: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.
translations.en.pickthall: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working on the river, and I wished to mar it, for there was a king behind them who is taking every ship by force.
translations.en.yusufali: "As for the boat, it belonged to certain men in dire want: they plied on the water: I but wished to render it unserviceable, for there was after them a certain king who seized on every boat by force.
translations.id.indonesian: Adapun bahtera itu adalah kepunyaan orang-orang miskin yang bekerja di laut, dan aku bertujuan merusakkan bahtera itu, karena di hadapan mereka ada seorang raja yang merampas tiap-tiap bahtera.

arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْغُلَٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَٰنًۭا وَكُفْرًۭا
transliteration: Wa aammal ghulaamu fakaana abawaahu mu'minaini fakhasheenaaa any yurhiqa humaa tughyaananw wa kufraa

translations.en.sahih: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.
translations.en.pickthall: And as for the lad, his parents were believers and we feared lest he should oppress them by rebellion and disbelief.
translations.en.yusufali: "As for the youth, his parents were people of Faith, and we feared that he would grieve them by obstinate rebellion and ingratitude (to Allah and man).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan adapun anak muda itu, maka keduanya adalah orang-orang mukmin, dan kami khawatir bahwa dia akan mendorong kedua orang tuanya itu kepada kesesatan dan kekafiran.

arabic: فَأَرَدْنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُ زَكَوٰةًۭ وَأَقْرَبَ رُحْمًۭا
transliteration: Faradnaa any yubdila humaa Rabbuhumaa khairam minhu zakaatanw wa aqraba ruhmaa

translations.en.sahih: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy.
translations.en.pickthall: And we intended that their Lord should change him for them for one better in purity and nearer to mercy.
translations.en.yusufali: "So we desired that their Lord would give them in exchange (a son) better in purity (of conduct) and closer in affection.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kami menghendaki, supaya Tuhan mereka mengganti bagi mereka dengan anak lain yang lebih baik kesuciannya dari anaknya itu dan lebih dalam kasih sayangnya (kepada ibu bapaknya).

arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَٰمَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُۥ كَنزٌۭ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَٰلِحًۭا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبْلُغَآ أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسْتَخْرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ وَمَا فَعَلْتُهُۥ عَنْ أَمْرِى ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَأْوِيلُ مَا لَمْ تَسْطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًۭا
transliteration: Wa ammal jidaaru fakaana lighulaamaini yateemaini fil madeenati wa kaana tahtahoo kanzul lahumaa wa kaana aboohumaa saalihan fa araada Rabbuka any yablughaaa ashuddahumaa wa yastakhrijaa kanzahumaa rahmatam mir Rabbik; wa maa fa'altuhoo 'an amree; zaalika taaweelu maa lam tasti' 'alaihi sabra

translations.en.sahih: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."
translations.en.pickthall: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure belonging to them, and their father had been righteous, and thy Lord intended that they should come to their full strength and should bring forth their treasure as a mercy from their Lord; and I did it not upon my own command. Such is the interpretation of that wherewith thou couldst not bear.
translations.en.yusufali: "As for the wall, it belonged to two youths, orphans, in the Town; there was, beneath it, a buried treasure, to which they were entitled: their father had been a righteous man: So thy Lord desired that they should attain their age of full strength and get out their treasure - a mercy (and favour) from thy Lord. I did it not of my own accord. Such is the interpretation of (those things) over which thou wast unable to hold patience."
translations.id.indonesian: Adapun dinding rumah adalah kepunyaan dua orang anak yatim di kota itu, dan di bawahnya ada harta benda simpanan bagi mereka berdua, sedang ayahnya adalah seorang yang saleh, maka Tuhanmu menghendaki agar supaya mereka sampai kepada kedewasaannya dan mengeluarkan simpanannya itu, sebagai rahmat dari Tuhanmu; dan bukanlah aku melakukannya itu menurut kemauanku sendiri. Demikian itu adalah tujuan perbuatan-perbuatan yang kamu tidak dapat sabar terhadapnya".

arabic: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِى ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ ۖ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْهُ ذِكْرًا
transliteration: Wa yas'aloonaka 'an Zil Qarnaini qul sa atloo 'alaikum minhu zikraa

translations.en.sahih: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report."
translations.en.pickthall: They will ask thee of Dhu'l-Qarneyn. Say: I shall recite unto you a remembrance of him.
translations.en.yusufali: They ask thee concerning Zul-qarnain. Say, "I will rehearse to you something of his story."
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka akan bertanya kepadamu (Muhammad) tentang Dzulkarnain. Katakanlah: "Aku akan bacakan kepadamu cerita tantangnya".

arabic: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ سَبَبًۭا
transliteration: Innaa makkannaa lahoo fil ardi wa aatainaahu min kulli shai'in sababaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed We established him upon the earth, and We gave him to everything a way.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We made him strong in the land and gave him unto every thing a road.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily We established his power on earth, and We gave him the ways and the means to all ends.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah memberi kekuasaan kepadanya di (muka) bumi, dan Kami telah memberikan kepadanya jalan (untuk mencapai) segala sesuatu,

arabic: فَأَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
transliteration: Fa atba'a sababaa

translations.en.sahih: So he followed a way
translations.en.pickthall: And he followed a road
translations.en.yusufali: One (such) way he followed,
translations.id.indonesian: maka diapun menempuh suatu jalan.

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغْرُبُ فِى عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍۢ وَوَجَدَ عِندَهَا قَوْمًۭا ۗ قُلْنَا يَٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِمَّآ أَن تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّآ أَن تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمْ حُسْنًۭا
transliteration: Hattaaa izaa balagha maghribash shamsi wajadahaaa taghrubu fee 'aynin hami'a tinw wa wajada 'indahaa qawmaa; qulnaa yaa Zal Qarnaini immaaa an tu'az ziba wa immaaa an tattakhiza feehim husnaa

translations.en.sahih: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it [as if] setting in a spring of dark mud, and he found near it a people. Allah said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or else adopt among them [a way of] goodness."
translations.en.pickthall: Till, when he reached the setting-place of the sun, he found it setting in a muddy spring, and found a people thereabout. We said: O Dhu'l-Qarneyn! Either punish or show them kindness.
translations.en.yusufali: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it set in a spring of murky water: Near it he found a People: We said: "O Zul-qarnain! (thou hast authority,) either to punish them, or to treat them with kindness."
translations.id.indonesian: Hingga apabila dia telah sampai ketempat terbenam matahari, dia melihat matahari terbenam di dalam laut yang berlumpur hitam, dan dia mendapati di situ segolongan umat. Kami berkata: "Hai Dzulkarnain, kamu boleh menyiksa atau boleh berbuat kebaikan terhadap mereka.

arabic: قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُۥ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ فَيُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًۭا نُّكْرًۭا
transliteration: Qaala amaa man zalama fasawfa nu'azzibuhoo summa yuraddu ilaa Rabbihee fa yu 'azzibuhoo azaaban nukraa

translations.en.sahih: He said, "As for one who wrongs, we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: As for him who doeth wrong, we shall punish him, and then he will be brought back unto his Lord, Who will punish him with awful punishment!
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "Whoever doth wrong, him shall we punish; then shall he be sent back to his Lord; and He will punish him with a punishment unheard-of (before).
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Dzulkarnain: "Adapun orang yang aniaya, maka kami kelak akan mengazabnya, kemudian dia kembalikan kepada Tuhannya, lalu Tuhan mengazabnya dengan azab yang tidak ada taranya.

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلَهُۥ جَزَآءً ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا يُسْرًۭا
transliteration: Wa ammaa man aamana wa 'amila saalihan falahoo jazaaa'anil husnaa wa sanaqoolu lahoo min amrinaa yusraa

translations.en.sahih: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of Paradise, and we will speak to him from our command with ease."
translations.en.pickthall: But as for him who believeth and doeth right, good will be his reward, and We shall speak unto him a mild command.
translations.en.yusufali: "But whoever believes, and works righteousness,- he shall have a goodly reward, and easy will be his task as We order it by our Command."
translations.id.indonesian: Adapun orang-orang yang beriman dan beramal saleh, maka baginya pahala yang terbaik sebagai balasan, dan akan kami titahkan kepadanya (perintah) yang mudah dari perintah-perintah kami".

arabic: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
transliteration: Summa atba'a sababaa

translations.en.sahih: Then he followed a way
translations.en.pickthall: Then he followed a road
translations.en.yusufali: Then followed he (another) way,
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian dia menempuh jalan (yang lain).

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ لَّمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتْرًۭا
transliteration: Hattaaa izaa balagha matli'ash shamsi wajdahaa tatlu'u alaa qawmil lam naj'al lahum min doonihaa sitraa

translations.en.sahih: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield.
translations.en.pickthall: Till, when he reached the rising-place of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had appointed no shelter therefrom.
translations.en.yusufali: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had provided no covering protection against the sun.
translations.id.indonesian: Hingga apabila dia telah sampai ke tempat terbit matahari (sebelah Timur) dia mendapati matahari itu menyinari segolongan umat yang Kami tidak menjadikan bagi mereka sesuatu yang melindunginya dari (cahaya) matahari itu,

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًۭا
transliteration: Kazaalika wa qad ahatnaa bimaa ladaihi khubraa

translations.en.sahih: Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.
translations.en.pickthall: So (it was). And We knew all concerning him.
translations.en.yusufali: (He left them) as they were: We completely understood what was before him.
translations.id.indonesian: demikianlah. dan sesungguhnya ilmu Kami meliputi segala apa yang ada padanya.

arabic: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
transliteration: Summa atba'a sababaa

translations.en.sahih: Then he followed a way
translations.en.pickthall: Then he followed a road
translations.en.yusufali: Then followed he (another) way,
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian dia menempuh suatu jalan (yang lain lagi).

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيْنَ ٱلسَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًۭا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًۭا
transliteration: Hattaaa izaa balagha bainas saddaini wajada min doonihimaa qawmal laa yakaa doona yafqahoona qawlaa

translations.en.sahih: Until, when he reached [a pass] between two mountains, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand [his] speech.
translations.en.pickthall: Till, when he came between the two mountains, he found upon their hither side a folk that scarce could understand a saying.
translations.en.yusufali: Until, when he reached (a tract) between two mountains, he found, beneath them, a people who scarcely understood a word.
translations.id.indonesian: Hingga apabila dia telah sampai di antara dua buah gunung, dia mendapati di hadapan kedua bukit itu suatu kaum yang hampir tidak mengerti pembicaraan.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
transliteration: Qaaloo yaa Zal qarnaini inna Yaajooja wa Maajooja mufsidoona fil ardi fahal naj'alu laka kharjan 'alaaa an taj'ala bainanaa wa bainahum saddas

translations.en.sahih: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?"
translations.en.pickthall: They said: O Dhu'l-Qarneyn! Lo! Gog and Magog are spoiling the land. So may we pay thee tribute on condition that thou set a barrier between us and them?
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "O Zul-qarnain! the Gog and Magog (People) do great mischief on earth: shall we then render thee tribute in order that thou mightest erect a barrier between us and them?
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Hai Dzulkarnain, sesungguhnya Ya'juj dan Ma'juj itu orang-orang yang membuat kerusakan di muka bumi, maka dapatkah kami memberikan sesuatu pembayaran kepadamu, supaya kamu membuat dinding antara kami dan mereka?"

arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
transliteration: Qaala maa makkannee feehi Rabbee khairun fa-a'eenoonee biquwwatin aj'al bainakum wa bainahum radmaa

translations.en.sahih: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength; I will make between you and them a dam.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: That wherein my Lord hath established me is better (than your tribute). Do but help me with strength (of men), I will set between you and them a bank.
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "(The power) in which my Lord has established me is better (than tribute): Help me therefore with strength (and labour): I will erect a strong barrier between you and them:
translations.id.indonesian: Dzulkarnain berkata: "Apa yang telah dikuasakan oleh Tuhanku kepadaku terhadapnya adalah lebih baik, maka tolonglah aku dengan kekuatan (manusia dan alat-alat), agar aku membuatkan dinding antara kamu dan mereka,

arabic: ءَاتُونِى زُبَرَ ٱلْحَدِيدِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيْنَ ٱلصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ ٱنفُخُوا۟ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَعَلَهُۥ نَارًۭا قَالَ ءَاتُونِىٓ أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًۭا
transliteration: Aatoonee zubaral hadeed, hattaaa izaa saawaa bainas sadafaini qaalan fukhoo hattaaa izaa ja'alahoo naaran qaala aatooneee ufrigh 'alaihi qitraa

translations.en.sahih: Bring me sheets of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper."
translations.en.pickthall: Give me pieces of iron - till, when he had levelled up (the gap) between the cliffs, he said: Blow! - till, when he had made it a fire, he said: Bring me molten copper to pour thereon.
translations.en.yusufali: "Bring me blocks of iron." At length, when he had filled up the space between the two steep mountain-sides, He said, "Blow (with your bellows)" Then, when he had made it (red) as fire, he said: "Bring me, that I may pour over it, molten lead."
translations.id.indonesian: berilah aku potongan-potongan besi". Hingga apabila besi itu telah sama rata dengan kedua (puncak) gunung itu, berkatalah Dzulkarnain: "Tiuplah (api itu)". Hingga apabila besi itu sudah menjadi (merah seperti) api, diapun berkata: "Berilah aku tembaga (yang mendidih) agar aku kutuangkan ke atas besi panas itu".

arabic: فَمَا ٱسْطَٰعُوٓا۟ أَن يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ لَهُۥ نَقْبًۭا
transliteration: Famas taa'ooo any yazharoohu wa mastataa'oo lahoo naqbaa

translations.en.sahih: So Gog and Magog were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.
translations.en.pickthall: And (Gog and Magog) were not able to surmount, nor could they pierce (it).
translations.en.yusufali: Thus were they made powerless to scale it or to dig through it.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka mereka tidak bisa mendakinya dan mereka tidak bisa (pula) melobanginya.

arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا رَحْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى جَعَلَهُۥ دَكَّآءَ ۖ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى حَقًّۭا
transliteration: Qaala haaza rahmatummir Rabbee fa izaa jaaa'a wa'du Rabbee ja'alahoo dakkaaa'a; wa kaana; wa du Rabbee haqqaa

translations.en.sahih: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord cometh to pass, He will lay it low, for the promise of my Lord is true.
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "This is a mercy from my Lord: But when the promise of my Lord comes to pass, He will make it into dust; and the promise of my Lord is true."
translations.id.indonesian: Dzulkarnain berkata: "Ini (dinding) adalah rahmat dari Tuhanku, maka apabila sudah datang janji Tuhanku, Dia akan menjadikannya hancur luluh; dan janji Tuhanku itu adalah benar".

arabic: ۞ وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَمُوجُ فِى بَعْضٍۢ ۖ وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَٰهُمْ جَمْعًۭا
transliteration: Wa taraknaa ba'dahum Yawma'iziny yamooju fee ba'dinw wa nufikha fis Soori fajama'naahum jam'aa

translations.en.sahih: And We will leave them that day surging over each other, and [then] the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly.
translations.en.pickthall: And on that day we shall let some of them surge against others, and the Trumpet will be blown. Then We shall gather them together in one gathering.
translations.en.yusufali: On that day We shall leave them to surge like waves on one another: the trumpet will be blown, and We shall collect them all together.
translations.id.indonesian: Kami biarkan mereka di hari itu bercampur aduk antara satu dengan yang lain, kemudian ditiup lagi sangkakala, lalu Kami kumpulkan mereka itu semuanya,

arabic: وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَرْضًا
transliteration: Wa 'aradnaa jahannama Yawma'izil lilkaafireena 'ardaa

translations.en.sahih: And We will present Hell that Day to the Disbelievers, on display -
translations.en.pickthall: On that day we shall present hell to the disbelievers, plain to view,
translations.en.yusufali: And We shall present Hell that day for Unbelievers to see, all spread out,-
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami nampakkan Jahannam pada hari itu kepada orang-orang kafir dengan jelas,

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِى غِطَآءٍ عَن ذِكْرِى وَكَانُوا۟ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا
transliteration: Allazeena kaanat a'yunuhum fee ghitaaa'in 'an zikree wa kaanoo la yastatee'oona sam'aa

translations.en.sahih: Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance, and they were not able to hear.
translations.en.pickthall: Those whose eyes were hoodwinked from My reminder, and who could not bear to hear.
translations.en.yusufali: (Unbelievers) whose eyes had been under a veil from remembrance of Me, and who had been unable even to hear.
translations.id.indonesian: yaitu orang-orang yang matanya dalam keadaan tertutup dari memperhatikan tanda-tanda kebesaran-Ku, dan adalah mereka tidak sanggup mendengar.

arabic: أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن يَتَّخِذُوا۟ عِبَادِى مِن دُونِىٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۚ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ نُزُلًۭا
transliteration: Afahasibal lazeena kafarooo any yattakhizoo 'ibaadee min dooneee awliyaaa'; innaaa a'tadnaa jahannama lilkaafi reena nuzulaa

translations.en.sahih: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.
translations.en.pickthall: Do the disbelievers reckon that they can choose My bondmen as protecting friends beside Me? Lo! We have prepared hell as a welcome for the disbelievers.
translations.en.yusufali: Do the Unbelievers think that they can take My servants as protectors besides Me? Verily We have prepared Hell for the Unbelievers for (their) entertainment.
translations.id.indonesian: maka apakah orang-orang kafir menyangka bahwa mereka (dapat) mengambil hamba-hamba-Ku menjadi penolong selain Aku? Sesungguhnya Kami telah menyediakan neraka Jahannam tempat tinggal bagi orang-orang kafir.

arabic: قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَٰلًا
transliteration: Qul hal nunabbi'ukum bilakhsareena a'maalaa

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?
translations.en.pickthall: Say: Shall We inform you who will be the greatest losers by their works?
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "Shall we tell you of those who lose most in respect of their deeds?-
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: "Apakah akan Kami beritahukan kepadamu tentang orang-orang yang paling merugi perbuatannya?"

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا
transliteration: Allazeena dalla sa'yuhum fil hayaatid dunyaa wa hum yahsaboona annahum yuhsinoona sun'aa

translations.en.sahih: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."
translations.en.pickthall: Those whose effort goeth astray in the life of the world, and yet they reckon that they do good work.
translations.en.yusufali: "Those whose efforts have been wasted in this life, while they thought that they were acquiring good by their works?"
translations.id.indonesian: Yaitu orang-orang yang telah sia-sia perbuatannya dalam kehidupan dunia ini, sedangkan mereka menyangka bahwa mereka berbuat sebaik-baiknya.

arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَزْنًۭا
transliteration: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena kafaroo bi aayaati Rabbihim wa liqaaa'ihee fahabitat a'maaluhum falaa nuqeemu lahum Yawmal Qiyaamati waznaa

translations.en.sahih: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any importance.
translations.en.pickthall: Those are they who disbelieve in the revelations of their Lord and in the meeting with Him. Therefor their works are vain, and on the Day of Resurrection We assign no weight to them.
translations.en.yusufali: They are those who deny the Signs of their Lord and the fact of their having to meet Him (in the Hereafter): vain will be their works, nor shall We, on the Day of Judgment, give them any weight.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka itu orang-orang yang telah kufur terhadap ayat-ayat Tuhan mereka dan (kufur terhadap) perjumpaan dengan Dia, maka hapuslah amalan-amalan mereka, dan Kami tidak mengadakan suatu penilaian bagi (amalan) mereka pada hari kiamat.

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِى وَرُسُلِى هُزُوًا
transliteration: Zaalika jazaaa'uhum jahannamu bimaa kafaroo wattakhazooo Aayaatee wa Rusulee huzuwaa

translations.en.sahih: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.
translations.en.pickthall: That is their reward: hell, because they disbelieved, and made a jest of Our revelations and Our messengers.
translations.en.yusufali: That is their reward, Hell, because they rejected Faith, and took My Signs and My Messengers by way of jest.
translations.id.indonesian: Demikianlah balasan mereka itu neraka Jahannam, disebabkan kekafiran mereka dan disebabkan mereka menjadikan ayat-ayat-Ku dan rasul-rasul-Ku sebagai olok-olok.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا
transliteration: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati kaanat lahum Jannaatul Firdawsi nuzulaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs are the Gardens of Paradise for welcome,
translations.en.yusufali: As to those who believe and work righteous deeds, they have, for their entertainment, the Gardens of Paradise,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang beriman dan beramal saleh, bagi mereka adalah surga Firdaus menjadi tempat tinggal,

arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًۭا
transliteration: Khaalideena feeha la yabghoona 'anhaa hiwalaa

translations.en.sahih: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.
translations.en.pickthall: Wherein they will abide, with no desire to be removed from thence.
translations.en.yusufali: Wherein they shall dwell (for aye): no change will they wish for from them.
translations.id.indonesian: mereka kekal di dalamnya, mereka tidak ingin berpindah dari padanya.

arabic: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ ٱلْبَحْرُ مِدَادًۭا لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّى لَنَفِدَ ٱلْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَٰتُ رَبِّى وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِۦ مَدَدًۭا
transliteration: Qul law kaanal bahru midaadal lik Kalimaati Rabbee lanafidal bahru qabla an tanfada Kalimaatu Rabbee wa law ji'naa bimislihee madadaa

translations.en.sahih: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it as a supplement."
translations.en.pickthall: Say: Though the sea became ink for the Words of my Lord, verily the sea would be used up before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even though We brought the like thereof to help.
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "If the ocean were ink (wherewith to write out) the words of my Lord, sooner would the ocean be exhausted than would the words of my Lord, even if we added another ocean like it, for its aid."
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: Sekiranya lautan menjadi tinta untuk (menulis) kalimat-kalimat Tuhanku, sungguh habislah lautan itu sebelum habis (ditulis) kalimat-kalimat Tuhanku, meskipun Kami datangkan tambahan sebanyak itu (pula)".

arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًۭا صَٰلِحًۭا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا
transliteration: Qul innamaaa ana basharum mislukum yoohaaa ilaiya annamaa ilaahukum Ilaahunw Waahid; faman kaana yarjoo liqaaa'a Rabbihee falya'mal 'amalan saalihanw wa laa yushrik bi'ibaadati Rabbiheee ahadaa

translations.en.sahih: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."
translations.en.pickthall: Say: I am only a mortal like you. My Lord inspireth in me that your Allah is only One Allah. And whoever hopeth for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous work, and make none sharer of the worship due unto his Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "I am but a man like yourselves, (but) the inspiration has come to me, that your Allah is one Allah: whoever expects to meet his Lord, let him work righteousness, and, in the worship of his Lord, admit no one as partner.
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: Sesungguhnya aku ini manusia biasa seperti kamu, yang diwahyukan kepadaku: "Bahwa sesungguhnya Tuhan kamu itu adalah Tuhan yang Esa". Barangsiapa mengharap perjumpaan dengan Tuhannya, maka hendaklah ia mengerjakan amal yang saleh dan janganlah ia mempersekutukan seorangpun dalam beribadat kepada Tuhannya".
